integrity.degree_basis: The projective-degree formula is independently reconstructed from the positive-root leading term of the Weyl dimension formula.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0410240 lists version 1 on 2004-10-09.
integrity.geometric_input_basis: The inspected full text defines partial flag varieties as homogeneous spaces, their Schubert affine-cell decomposition, and fundamental-weight Pluecker line bundles.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The arXiv record lists Algebraic Geometry and MSC 14M15, 14N15 as its leading classification codes.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only two-step line flags \(F(1,k;n)\), not arbitrary partial flag types.
The degree is taken in the natural Segre–Pluecker polarization \(\mathcal O(1,1)\).
The comparison is elementary after the Weyl leading-coefficient and Schubert-cell formulas are specialized, so an unindexed older source may contain the same inequality.
title: Segre–Pluecker degree dominates Euler characteristic for two-step line flags
